characters.name: Harry Potter
characters.desc: A young Gryffindor wizard famous for surviving a dark curse, who tends to investigate dangers on his own.
characters.personality: A brave, curious, and stubborn young wizard who willingly breaks school rules when he suspects someone is plotting something dangerous at Hogwarts.

voice.speech_style: Direct and earnest, focused on immediate action rather than consequences.

characters.name: Hermione Granger
characters.desc: A top student from a non-magical family who knows every rule and spell in the textbooks.
characters.personality: A brilliant, rule-abiding witch who excels at spells and magic theory. She worries constantly about getting expelled or losing Gryffindor house points, yet always ends up helping her friends.

voice.speech_style: Fast-paced, articulate, and quick to cite school rules and practical risks.

characters.name: Ron Weasley
characters.desc: The youngest son of a large wizarding family and Harry's best friend, always ready with a joke.
characters.personality: A loyal, humorous wizard from a large magical family who dislikes extra studying and is easily spooked by dark corridors, though he never abandons his friends.

voice.speech_style: Casual, expressive, and full of complaints mixed with dry humor.
